question: Who has been appointed as the Air Officer Commanding-in-Chief of the Central Air Command with effect from June 1, 2026?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Air Marshal Tarun Chaudhry**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Air Marshal Tarun Chaudhry**, AVSM, VSM, assumed the appointment of **Air Officer Commanding-in-Chief (AOC-in-C)**, **Central Air Command** on **June 1, 2026**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Air Marshal Tarun Chaudhry** took charge of the **Central Air Command** on the first of June, 2026.
 
• He succeeds **Air Marshal Balakrishnan Manikantan**, who superannuated from the service on **May 31, 2026**.
 
• The transition marks a change in leadership for the **Central Air Command** of the **Indian Air Force (IAF)**.
 
• **Air Marshal Balakrishnan Manikantan** retired after **40 years** of distinguished and devoted service to the nation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• The appointment was officially announced by the **Ministry of Defence** via **PIB Delhi**.
 
• The predecessor, **Air Marshal Balakrishnan Manikantan**, held the titles of **PVSM, AVSM, and VM** at the time of his superannuation.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

 
• This appointment is part of the regular high-level leadership transitions within the **Indian Air Force**.
 
• The **Central Air Command** is one of the functional arms of the IAF, overseeing operations in its designated geographic area.
